title: The Evolution of Written Language: From Cuneiform to Alphabets

coreVocabulary.contextSentence: Sumerian scribes pressed wedge-shaped reed styluses into wet clay to produce cuneiform script.

coreVocabulary.viDefinition: người sao chép, thư lại cổ đại
